data.title: WSJ: Iran prepared for long war, fearing US talks were cover for Israeli attack | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: According to the WSJ, Arab intelligence officials picked up evidence of Iranian leaders planning potential attacks on enemy territory, broadening the scope of the war and raising the cost for the US.
